observed.description: Observed pump price is authoritative for today's displayed tank cost. Taxes are separated from it; the remainder is explicitly a residual, not profit.

simulation.description: Freeze observed market conditions at a reference timestamp and alter only documented policy variables.
simulation.formula: frozen_market_reference + documented_policy_costs + energy_tax + carbon_tax -> VAT -> simulated_pump_price

reduction_duty.note: GHG reduction obligation; not interpreted as a direct volume blend percentage.

market_chain_residual.note: Must never be described as pure profit.

safeguards: Every political numeric input requires source and validity.
Do not equate reduction-duty percentage with biofuel volume percentage.
Do not present a market residual as company profit.
